nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Quick Calming Pad

segments.oily: A reviewer with combination skin that turns oily in summer found the pads left slight dryness the next day, which she expects to suit the oilier season better; another notes his skin used to swing to very oily before normalizing with use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the pads feel hydrating and reduce dry patches and dry spots in colder months, with one noting her normally-dry skin felt great and another saying it helped both dryness and acne.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including one with combo eczema-prone skin that shifts oily in summer) report the pads calm redness and inflammation and leave skin soft, though one noticed next-day dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, but one sensitive-skin reviewer reports the product caused breakouts on the areas she applied it.
segments.normal: One reviewer felt the pads were only okay for her skin but suspects they would work well for normal skin.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers across skin types report the pads leave skin hydrated, plump, soft, and smooth, with effects sometimes lasting until the next morning; no dissent reported.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including those with rosacea, lupus-related 'butterfly rash,' and general facial redness, report the pads reduce redness quickly and calm inflammation without stinging; no negative reports on this concern.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using the pads after retin-A, glycolic acid burns, waxing, or razor burn report the pads soothed irritation and reduced sensitivity, with one noting a mild burning sensation on open cuts that faded quickly.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product reduced dry spots caused by cold weather; not otherwise discussed.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with eczema found the pads reduced flare-ups on the face and body; not extensively discussed beyond that.
concerns.oiliness: Not directly addressed; one combination-skin reviewer expects the pads to work better during her oilier summer months.

aspects.libelle: Pads bunch up or are too flimsy
Packaging with tweezers keeps pads sanitary
Pad size too large for some facial areas
Perceived value given quantity of product

extraits.texte: Great formulation but frustratingly flimsy pads that bunch up; very annoying. I don't recommend these pads.

extraits.titre: I do not think I would personally buy this product
extraits.texte: This gave an extremely hydrating glow and overall looked very nice, however it made the parts of my face I put it on breakout, as I have sensitive skin. If someone were to ask for a hydrating glow I would recommend this.

I have been using these calming pads from SKIN1004 for about a week now, and I really, really love them! I have dry skin, especially in the cooler months, but I also have non-painful redness due to my Lupus. I gets what is called a "butterfly rash" across my nose and cheeks. I like to apply these pads over my nose, top of my cheeks and also occasionally on my forehead after cleansing to calm any of that redness. It also just feels amazing to have these on for a few minutes after I wash my face. My skin is dry normally so it feels awesome! They use centella which is absolutely great for the skin! The packaging is lovely, and it comes with a secondary lid where you can store the little tweezers that they include to keep the pads sanitary. No fragrance so no issues with irritation. This is a 10/10 for my skin. LOVE! Gifted by SKIN1004 in exchange for my review, but this is my honest opinion.

These pads are simply wonderful to reduce redness, itching, inflammation and anything happening on my combination skin. I love to leave them on my skin for 15-20 minutes before heading out and my skin looks and feels refreshed and shiny.

I was so excited to try this product since I have seen similar products like it in the K-beauty world. I have combo eczema prone skin that trends more dry in the winter and oily in the summers. I love having a patch I can place in my eczema flare ups and after using it I can tell my skin is super soft and smooth. Also these stay in place really well; I didn't have to fuss over them sliding down like other sheet masks and patches do. I did notice some dryness in my skin the next day which I don't mind since it will be perfect for when my skin is more oily during the summer. I did receive this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I've never used a product like this before so initially I was a little concerned it may break me out but honestly it hasn't. I have the dry skin that somehow fluctuates between very try or you could cook food with the oil on my face. I feel like since I started using this product I'm more in the normal skin range. It helps a lot with irritation I sometimes get from using retin-a. I would highly recommend.

This product is so soothing! I have eczema and sensitive skin. I keep the pads in the refrigerator so they feel even better when I apply them to my skin! It doesn't irritate my face at all. Highly recommend!!
